name: tapnow
description: TapNow is the AI creative engine for brands and creators: images, video and product visuals, made in conversation and kept in your TapNow canvas.

interface.longDescription:
TapNow is the AI creative engine for brands and creators. Start from a brief, a product photo or a script, and TapNow brings together a range of image and video models to turn it into finished work: campaign visuals, product imagery, illustrations and short films.

Everything you make lands in your TapNow canvas, where you and your team can keep refining it, and your TapNow asset library is right there in the conversation when you need it.

Built-in skills take on the bigger jobs: a complete product listing set from one photo, a campaign that stays on brand across every placement, and a storyboarded short film made shot by shot.

The first time you use TapNow, you sign in with your TapNow account and approve access. Generations run on that account, videos take a few minutes, and each video comes back as a separate clip for you to arrange into a final cut.
defaultPrompt: Create a 16:9 hero image of a ceramic coffee mug on a sunlit wooden table
Make white-background and lifestyle Amazon shots from a product photo in my TapNow library
Make a 5-second vertical video of ocean waves rolling onto a beach at sunset

positive.description: Single image from a text prompt. The assistant calls create_image with a 16:9 aspect ratio (default model), then polls get_production_result until the image is done.
positive.prompt: Use TapNow to create one 16:9 image of a minimalist ceramic coffee mug on a sunlit wooden table for a website banner. Use the default model and resolution.
positive.expected_behavior: One finished 16:9 image of a ceramic mug on a wooden table is shown or linked, together with a link to the TapNow canvas project that holds it.

positive.description: E-commerce product shots from a sample product photo already stored in the test account's TapNow library (folder "Review samples", image "sample-mug"). The assistant brings the library photo in with upload_image, then calls create_product_shots.
positive.prompt: Find the product photo named sample-mug in my TapNow library and make Amazon listing images from it: one white-background shot and one lifestyle scene.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant locates sample-mug in the library and returns two finished 1:1 images of the same mug (white background and lifestyle scene) with a link to the TapNow project. The product looks the same as in the source photo.

positive.description: A consistent set of deck illustrations from a short outline. The assistant passes the four sections as the outline and a style description.
positive.prompt: Create illustrations for a 4-slide deck about our Q3 sustainability report: introduction, supply chain, carbon reduction, next steps. Clean, airy corporate style.
positive.expected_behavior: Four images in one consistent clean corporate style, one per section, with no text inside the images, plus a link to the TapNow project.

positive.description: Short preview video. The prompt already gives the go-ahead for the video render, so the assistant calls create_video right away with the default model, 5 seconds, 9:16, then keeps polling get_production_result while the video renders (this takes a few minutes).
positive.prompt: Use TapNow to generate a 5-second vertical (9:16) video of ocean waves gently rolling onto a beach at sunset for social media, with the default model and settings. I've already approved this video render, so start it now without asking me again, keep checking its status until it's done, then give me the video and the TapNow project link.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant starts the video without asking for confirmation again, says rendering takes a few minutes, and keeps checking with get_production_result. When it returns done, the assistant gives a 5-second 9:16 video of waves at sunset (playable or as a link) and the link to the TapNow project.

positive.description: Read-only look at the test account's asset library: list one folder, then open the library panel on it. Nothing is generated or changed.
positive.prompt: What images do I have in my TapNow library folder Review samples? List them, then open that folder in the TapNow library for me.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant lists the images in the Review samples folder (including sample-mug) by name, then opens the TapNow library panel on that folder so the reviewer can browse the previews. Nothing is generated or changed.

negative.description: General writing request with no visual output. The plugin should not be called; the assistant answers directly.
negative.prompt: Write a three-line haiku about autumn leaves.

negative.description: General knowledge question about image formats. No image needs to be created or found, so the plugin should not be called; the assistant answers directly.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between JPEG and PNG?

negative.description: Deletion request. TapNow has no delete tool; the plugin should not be called and the assistant should say it can't delete library items from ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Delete every image in my TapNow library.

publication.release_notes: A simpler listing and three built-in skills: product shots, campaign visuals and storyboarded short films. Choose the model for images and videos, and use your own images or images from your TapNow library as references.
